| 2026-05-23 | Multiple skills were maintaining the same decision criteria inline, creating duplication. Consolidate shared knowledge for creator skills in `references/` and reference it from each skill. | [detail](../../references/incidents/creator-skill-inline-duplication.md) |
| 2026-05-24 | The merge skill auto-executed `git merge` without explicit user instruction. Even if permission was granted earlier in the session, each merge requires a separate instruction. | 2026-05-24 | The `.work/specs/` folder name implied official specifications, causing it to be treated as important documentation even though it is not auto-loaded by AI, leading to it becoming stale. | 2026-05-24 | The merge skill called conversation-to-claude from the master cwd, so generated glossary/incidents were committed directly to master instead of being included in the PR branch.
